agency: Department of Housing and Urban Development
summary: HUD's Assistant Secretary Harold B. Finger confirmed that Pratt and Whitney had not recommended fuel cell use in HUD's demonstration programs at this stage, that HUD staff concurred, and that HUD remained open to demonstrating the technology when it reached an appropriate level of readiness.
text:
Pratt and Whitney has not suggested that we consider the use of the fuel cell at this stace of its development in our deconstration programs, and my staff concurs in that decision.
We would be delighted to demonstrate the technology at the appropriate time.
